name: hetu-chatgpt
description: Connect HETU study context and learning workflows through its Python MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Save and retrieve sourced study learning.
interface.longDescription: Connect to a HETU account for learning captures, concept review, durable task briefs, and mapped section records. Additional whole-app actions are still being developed.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use my connected HETU account to help with this study task. Retrieve relevant context first, preserve my goal and constraints, and verify any saved work.
